items.name: Fade
items.summary: The classic cross-fade. Safe on every kind of site.

items.name: Colour Flash
items.summary: Page fades to a brand colour, then up into the next page.

items.name: Blur Dissolve
items.summary: Pages dissolve through a soft blur. Calm and modern.

items.name: Zoom
items.summary: The new page grows into view while the old one recedes.

items.name: Slide Up
items.summary: New page rises from below while the old one lifts away.

items.name: Slide Sideways
items.summary: A gentle horizontal drift, as if turning a page.

items.name: Push
items.summary: The old page is pushed off-screen by the new one.

items.name: Cover
items.summary: New page slides over the old one, which dims behind it.

items.name: Reveal
items.summary: The old page slides away to reveal the new one beneath.

items.name: Sheet
items.summary: New page slides up like a sheet; the old one steps back.

items.name: Wipe Up
items.summary: A clean horizontal edge wipes the new page into place.

items.name: Circle Reveal
items.summary: A circle opens from the centre to reveal the next page.

items.name: Diagonal Wipe
items.summary: A slanted edge sweeps across the screen.

items.name: Flip
items.summary: A 3D turn between pages. Bold — use sparingly.

items.name: Shutter blinds
items.summary: The next page opens through eight horizontal blinds that widen until they meet.

items.name: Curtain split
items.summary: The new page opens from a centre seam like a stage curtain while the old page recedes.

items.name: Ink bleed
items.summary: Five soft-edged blots spread from different points and merge into the next page.

items.name: Halftone dots
items.summary: A halftone grid of dots swells until the next page is fully printed.

items.name: Glitch
items.summary: A short digital glitch: colour-shifted slices jitter, then the new page snaps in clean.

items.name: Door swing
items.summary: The old page swings open on a left-hand hinge like a door, revealing the new page behind it.

items.name: Diamond spin
items.summary: A diamond spins half a turn as it grows from the centre of the screen, uncovering the new page while the old one sinks back.

items.name: Slice stagger
items.summary: The new page rises in five vertical strips, one after another from left to right, until they meet.
